purpose: HoldThatSmile customer and operations app for ordering custom clear retainers: impression-kit and production tracking, account management, payments, and an admin dashboard for orders, customers and manufacturing.

features.name: Customer ordering and order tracking
features.description: Seeded customer dashboard, seven-stage order journey, three-step retainers checkout with delivery validation and demo payment, order archive, reorder and customer notifications.
features.evidence: node scripts/verify.mjs -> 10/10 passed; node scripts/render-smoke.mjs -> overview, orders, order detail and checkout routes render; node scripts/smoke.mjs -> entry and deep link return 200.
done_criteria: Customer can place an order and see it in their order history
Customer can follow impression kit, lab, shipping and delivery stages
Customer dashboard and detail routes render from seeded data
Verification ran and output is recorded in progress.md

features.name: Customer account and preferences
features.description: Profile, shipping address, lab care notes, notification preferences, payment method on file and smile history summary.
features.evidence: node scripts/verify.mjs -> profile update persists and invalid email is rejected; node scripts/render-smoke.mjs -> #/account renders and save path is present.
done_criteria: Profile and address data can be edited and saved
Notification preferences and lab notes persist
Verification ran and output is recorded in progress.md

features.name: Staff operations console
features.description: Demo staff PIN gate, live metrics, order search and filters, payment review and collection, stage advancement, production board, customer book and payment ledger.
features.evidence: node scripts/verify.mjs -> advancement, payment blocking/collection and metrics pass; node scripts/render-smoke.mjs -> admin unlock, production tab and order modal render; node scripts/smoke.mjs -> app modules and SPA routes return 200.
done_criteria: Staff can unlock operations with the demo PIN
Staff can view orders, production, customers and payments
Staff can collect a pending payment and advance manufacturing stages
Customer-facing timeline updates after a staff action
Verification ran and output is recorded in progress.md

features.name: Production backend, auth and payment provider
features.description: Replace the demo store with an authenticated API and database, add server-enforced customer/staff roles, real Stripe payment intents and webhooks, transactional email/SMS and carrier tracking events.
done_criteria: Orders and customers persist in a real database
Customer and staff authorization is enforced server-side
A real payment provider processes test-mode charges and webhooks
Email/SMS and carrier tracking are connected
Verification and deployment are recorded in progress.md
